units.source_text: 到了九月初，我又要到东京去了。

en.t: At the beginning of September, I had to go to Tokyo again.

units.source_text: 我要求父亲暂时还像以前那样给我寄学费。

en.t: I asked my father to keep sending me school expenses for the time being, just as before.

units.source_text: “老是待在家里，是找不到你所希望的那种好工作的。”

en.t: If I stay at home all the time, I will never find the kind of good job you are hoping for.

units.source_text: 我说是为了寻找父亲所期待的那种职位才去东京的。

en.t: I said that I was going to Tokyo in order to look for the kind of position my father expected.

units.source_text: 我还说：“当然了，我找到工作以后，就不用寄钱了。”

en.t: I also said, "Of course, once I find a job, you will not need to send me money anymore."

units.source_text: 其实我心里想的是，这种好事怎么会落到我头上来。

en.t: In truth, I was thinking that such good fortune would never come my way.

units.source_text: 可是，不了解外面情况的父亲，却一直固执己见。

en.t: But my father, who did not understand the situation outside, stubbornly clung to his own view.

units.source_text: “这是暂时的，我会给你汇钱的，但是长期这样可不行噢。

en.t: "This is only temporary; I will send you money, but you cannot keep on like this for long.

units.source_text: 找到好工作后，就得慢慢养活自己了。

en.t: Once you find a good job, you must gradually support yourself.

units.source_text: 既然毕了业，按说第二天开始就不能再靠家里养活了。

en.t: Once you have graduated, strictly speaking, you should no longer depend on the family from the very next day.

units.source_text: 现在的年轻人，光知道花钱，压根儿不去想法子挣钱。”

en.t: Young people nowadays only know how to spend money and never think of ways to earn it."

units.source_text: 除了这些，父亲还发了半天牢骚。

en.t: Besides this, my father went on grumbling for quite a while.

units.source_text: 其中有这样一句话：“从前是儿子养活老家，如今却是老家养活儿子。”

en.t: Among his complaints was this line: "In the old days, sons supported the family home; now the family home supports the sons."

units.source_text: 对这些话我只有默默地听着。

en.t: I could only listen to these words in silence.

units.source_text: 感觉父亲的牢骚告一段落后，我刚想轻轻站起身离开房间时，父亲忽然问起我什么时候走，我当然是希望越早越好。

en.t: When I felt my father's grumbling had come to an end and was just about to rise quietly and leave the room, he suddenly asked when I would go; naturally, I wanted it to be as soon as possible.

units.source_text: “让你妈定个日子吧。”

en.t: "Have your mother choose a date."

units.source_text: “好吧。”

en.t: "All right."

units.source_text: 那时我在父亲面前格外乖顺，

en.t: At that time, I was unusually obedient in front of my father,

units.source_text: 我想尽量不跟他老人家闹别扭，顺利地离开故乡。

en.t: I wanted to avoid crossing him as much as possible and leave my hometown without trouble.

units.source_text: 父亲又叫住我，对我说道：

en.t: My father stopped me again and said to me:
